title: Scenic Sri Lanka Tour with Sigiriya and Ella
highlights: Immerse yourself in the rich history of Sri Lanka by exploring ancient temples, including the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress and the Hanuman Temple
Visit tea plantations, witness the tea-making process, and enjoy panoramic views of the picturesque landscapes
Taste the flavors of Sri Lankan cuisine, from spicy curries to delectable street food like hoppers and kottu roti
Witness the vibrant culture at the Temple of the Tooth Relic, explore the Royal Botanical Gardens, and immerse yourself in the local markets
Visit a local turtle hatchery and learn about the different turtle species and their life cycle
overview:
Enjoy a captivating tour of the pearl of the Indian Ocean – Sri Lanka. Visit Colombo, a city that buzzes with vibrant energy. Explore the lively markets of Pettah, where the air is filled with the scent of exotic spices and colorful fabrics. Wander through the historic Fort area, a place where old-world charm meets modern vibes. Travel to Kandy, the cultural heartland, and marvel at the beautiful Temple of the Tooth and the scenic Kandy Lake. Immerse yourself in the rhythmic beats of traditional Kandyan dance, embracing the cultural richness that defines this city.


Venture into the misty hills of Nuwara Eliya, where emerald tea plantations sprawl across the landscape, offering a refreshing escape. Learn the art of tea-making and enjoy the cool breeze by Gregory Lake. Continue your sojourn to Bentota, a coastal haven where golden beaches meet the gentle waves of the Indian Ocean. Whether you indulge in water sports, unwind on the sandy shores, or embark on a scenic boat ride along the Bentota River. This multi-faceted journey through Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Bentota, and Colombo weaves together the cultural, natural, and coastal charms of Sri Lanka, creating a tapestry of memories.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Colombo to Kandy | Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
days.desc: Upon arrival, the representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your hotel in Kandy. On the way, visit the Pinnwala Elephant Orphanage and see rescued Asian elephants in the Pinnwala village. Arrive in Kandy and check in to your hotel. Later in the evening, take in the panoramic views on Upper Lake Drive and enjoy a Kandyan Dance performance with a spectacular finale. After the visit, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

After the excursion, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | Admire the Scenic Views From Gregory Lake
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and the representative will transfer you to your hotel in Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya. Visit Gregory Lake and you can go for a scenic boat ride on the lake. Then, visit Hanuman Temple and see religious ceremonies being performed. Continue to Ramboda Falls and take in the breathtaking views. After the tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Sightseeing Tour of Nuwara Eliya
items.desc:
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the Gregory lakeside promenade and admire the beautiful views of the lake.
You can also go for a boat ride on Gregory Lake and take in the scenic beauty of the lake and the surrounding hills.
Explore the Hanuman Temple, which is believed to the resting stop of Lord Hanuman as he was searching for goddess Sita.
Look at the beautiful Ramboda Falls, one of the highest waterfalls in Sri Lanka and look at the cascading water surrounded by verdant landscapes.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella | Visit the Ravana Ella Caves
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Ella. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Ella. Explore the mysterious Ravana Ella Caves steeped in legend and mythology. Then, head to Nine Arch Bridge and marvel at the engineering ingenuity of the bridge. Then, visit the majestic Ravana Waterfalls. After sightseeing, the representative will transfer you back to your hotel in Ella for an overnight stay.

items.title: Sightseeing Tour of Ella
items.desc:
Visit Ravana Ella Caves and admire the ancient cave paintings that adorn the walls. 
Marvel at the impressive Nine Arch Bridge and admire the stunning arches and the surrounding natural scenery.
Take in the spectacular sight of Ravana Falls, one of Sri Lanka's most beautiful waterfalls.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota | The City of the Golden Beaches
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and the representative will take you to your hotel in Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Visit Madu River and you can enjoy a scenic boat ride on the river. Then, visit Fish Pedicure Centre and enjoy a relaxing spa experience as the fish gently exfoliates your skin. Then, explore the turtle hatchery. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the banks of Madu River and take in the picturesque views of the surroundings.
You can go on a scenic river cruise along the Madu River and cruise through mangrove tunnels with scenic vistas.
Immerse your feet in a tank filled with fish and enjoy a relaxing and unique spa experience.
Visit a turtle hatchery and see adorable turtles and learn about the conservation efforts aimed at protecting sea turtles.

days.title: Bentota to Colombo | Explore The Commercial Capital of Sri Lanka
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Colombo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Colombo. Visit Lotus Tower and enjoy panoramic views of Colombo. Then, walk across the Suspension Bridge. Then, wander through Colombo Fort and explore the floating market. Continue to World Trade Building. In the evening, you can explore the shopping streets. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Ascend to the Lotus Tower's observation deck and take in the picturesque views of Colombo. 
Feel the exhilaration as you walk across the suspension bridge and admire the stunning views of the surroundings, including rivers, valleys, and lush green landscapes.
Explore Colombo Fort, the historic district of Colombo and stroll along the charming streets filled with a mix of old and new architecture.
Visit the Floating Market in Pettah, a unique shopping experience built alongside Beira Lake and explore a variety of stalls selling local handicrafts, souvenirs, and street food. 
Explore the World Trade Center (WTC) Twin Towers, a prominent landmark in Colombo.

days.title: Departure | Take a Bag Full of Memories to Cherish
